summary: 043 correctly separates targetMainPreIntegrationCommit from terminal acceptedMainCommit, keeps exact singleton repository-integration Owner authority, one ordinary final commit, provider-external review/merge, state-first continuity and terminal next-base STOP without new Git/provider/promotion infrastructure. Revise Proposal to require exact accepted-main content equivalence with the already-proven finalized candidate (prefer tree(acceptedMainCommit) == tree(finalCommit), or equivalent exact candidate derivation).
